title: Japanese Park Rohini - History, Timings, Attractions & Travel Guide
content:
Japanese Park Rohini - Delhi, 

Japanese Park in Rohini (also known as Swarn Jayanti Park) is one of the most visited and family-friendly parks in Delhi. Spread over 250 acres, it is known for its lush greenery, boating facilities, jogging tracks, and open play areas. The park is designed with Japanese landscaping elements, making it a unique and refreshing escape within the city.

It is a favorite spot for morning walkers, families, couples, and children, offering a calm environment for relaxation as well as fun activities.

History of Japanese Park:

Japanese Park, or Swarn Jayanti Park, was developed by the Delhi Development Authority (DDA) as a modern green space for residents of Rohini and nearby areas. Over the years, it has become a major landmark in North West Delhi, attracting both locals and tourists for its well-maintained lawns, water bodies, and recreational options.

Things to See and Do at Japanese Park Rohini:

  •  Jogging & Walking Tracks – Long, tree-lined paths perfect for fitness lovers.
  •  Boating – Paddle boating and water rides in the lakes.
  •  Children’s Play Areas – Playgrounds with swings and slides for kids.
  •  Picnic Spots – Wide lawns for family outings and gatherings.
  •  Photography – A popular spot for pre-wedding and casual photoshoots.

Best Time to Visit: Japanese Park can be visited throughout the year, but the best time is from October to March, when the weather is pleasant for boating, picnics, and outdoor activities.

Visitor Information:

  • Location: Sector 10, Rohini, New Delhi
  • Timings: 5:00 AM – 8:00 PM (Daily)
  • Entry Fee: Free
  • Boating Charges: Around ₹50 – ₹100 per person (depending on ride type)
  • Parking Information: Paid parking available near the main entrance.

How to Reach:

  •  Nearest Metro Station: Rohini West Metro Station (Red Line)
  •  By Bus/Auto: Well connected via DTC buses and autos from all parts of Delhi.
  •  By Car: Easy road connectivity with dedicated parking space.

Places to Visit Nearby:

  • Adventure Island – Popular amusement and water park just next to Japanese Park.
  • Metro Walk Mall – Great for shopping and dining.
  • Dilli Haat Pitampura – Cultural shopping and food hub.

Travel Tip: Visit in the evening to enjoy boating and a peaceful sunset view by the lakeside.
excerpt: Japanese Park Rohini is one of the largest and most beautiful parks in Delhi, offering boating, play zones, and picnic spaces. With its Japanese-style landscaping and family-friendly atmosphere, it’s a perfect weekend escape in North Delhi.
